hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Northern Asia, between China and Russia || vast semidesert and desert plains, grassy steppe, mountains in west and southwest; Gobi Desert in south-central || landlocked; strategic location between China and Russia || Resources: oil, coal, copper, molybdenum, tungsten, phosphates, tin, nickel, zinc, fluorspar, gold, silver, iron || Exports: coal, copper ore, gold, iron ore, crude petroleum (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: vast semidesert and desert plains, grassy steppe, mountains in west and southwest; Gobi Desert in south-central || Northern Asia, between China and Russia

climate.excerpt: desert; continental (large daily and seasonal temperature ranges) || dust storms; grassland and forest fires; drought; "zud," which is harsh winter conditions

economy.excerpt: lower middle-income East Asian economy; large human capital improvements over last 3 decades; agricultural and natural resource rich; export and consumption-led growth; high inflation due to supply bottlenecks and increased food and energy prices; currency depreciation || Exports: coal, copper ore, gold, iron ore, crude petroleum (2023) || Industries: construction and construction materials; mining (coal, copper, molybdenum, fluorspar, tin, tungsten, gold); oil; food and beverages; processing of animal products, cashmere and natural fiber manufacturing
